summary: Implemented the desktop Admin master-data surfaces for ADM-09 Categories, ADM-10 Locations, and ADM-11 Features. The feature uses the implemented taxonomy, location, and feature CRUD contracts, preserves server availableActions and safe projections, validates reason-bearing mutations, covers loading, empty, error, retry, success, and permission states, and supports Arabic RTL, English LTR, and Simplified Chinese LTR.
